purpose: Complete deterministic synthetic UiState base contract for every state named in Master Plan section 5.5, plus phase profiles that derive narrower implementation contracts without copying a second fixture file. Only mandatory matrices are rendered as PNG.

sharedData.taskPrompt: Organize my travel receipts by month. Show every change before writing.
sharedData.privacyRule: Fixtures contain aliases only and never contain tokens, real user paths, or Android content URIs.

P2.purpose: Binding Android Task Shell projection. P2 has no SAF grant, file picker, file permission probe, file operation, media permission, or Accessibility capability.

S1.rule: P2 TaskHome has no Files destination or file-navigation affordance.

mergeDisabledReasons.AddAttachment: Attachments are not available until P5.

S2.rule: Hide GrantChip and picker. Agent permission remains a separate Host-side mode.

S8.rule: Render one read-only unavailable row; do not claim a grant exists.

S2-empty.expectedSemantics: Disabled Send exposes the empty-draft reason; no grant selector is present.

S2-new-valid.expectedSemantics: Agent permission is named as Host-side and does not imply Android folder access.

S2-attachment-unavailable.expectedSemantics: Attachments and mobile folders are explicitly unavailable and no picker action exists.

S8-unpaired.visibleData: No Host; Pair Host; no mobile folder capability in P2.
S8-unpaired.expectedSemantics: Unpaired state does not claim that a local folder grant exists.

S8-settings.visibleData: Connected Mac Studio; read-only agent profile; system theme; Mobile files unavailable.
S8-settings.expectedSemantics: Host state and the unavailable mobile-file row are separate and neither implies a folder grant.

S8-host-offline.expectedSemantics: Offline is distinct from unpaired and does not imply a folder-permission change.

S8-host-revoked.visibleData: Paired credential revoked; Pair again; Mobile files unavailable.
S8-host-revoked.expectedSemantics: Credential revoke is a Host-auth state; P2 does not claim an Android grant state.

P2_5.purpose: Binding S1 TaskHome and S2 NewTask implementation contract. It narrows the P2 phase projection without copying a second fixture catalog.

S1-home-empty.visibleData: Connected paired Host; no tasks; New task is the primary action.
S1-home-empty.expectedSemantics: Announce the empty task list and expose New task as the primary action.

S1-loading.visibleData: Connecting to the paired Host; deterministic task loading rows; New task is unavailable.
S1-loading.expectedSemantics: Announce loading once with text and do not represent it by color alone.

S1-home-ready.visibleData: One task needs attention; one task is running; two recent tasks; no Files destination.
S1-home-ready.expectedSemantics: Traverse needs-attention, running, then recent task groups in that priority order.

S1-home-attention.visibleData: Approval and question tasks appear before running and recent tasks without claiming file operations.
S1-home-attention.expectedSemantics: Each attention row names whether it needs approval or contains a question.

S1-home-offline.visibleData: Cached tasks remain visible; paired Host is offline; Retry connection is available.
S1-home-offline.expectedSemantics: State that tasks are cached and distinguish offline from unpaired.

S1-reconnecting.visibleData: Cached tasks remain visible while reconnecting with an attempt count; reconnect cannot be cancelled.
S1-reconnecting.expectedSemantics: Distinguish reconnecting from connected and offline and announce the attempt count.

S1-no-host.visibleData: No paired Host; Pair Host is available; this is not an empty connected task list.
S1-no-host.expectedSemantics: Distinguish the unpaired product state from a connected Host with zero tasks.

S1-running.visibleData: A task is running with a generic running summary and no unverified tool or file claim.
S1-running.expectedSemantics: Expose running with icon and text rather than color alone.

S1-waiting.visibleData: A task waits for approval or an answer and exposes its pending attention action.
S1-waiting.expectedSemantics: Include the waiting reason in the accessible task-row name.

S1-completed-unread.visibleData: A completed task has an unread final-result marker; opening the row is the only mark-read path.
S1-completed-unread.expectedSemantics: Announce completed and unread as separate states without a separate Mark read control.

S1-completed-read.visibleData: A completed task is already read and remains distinct from a running task.
S1-completed-read.expectedSemantics: Announce read completion distinctly from running.

S1-failed.visibleData: A task-level failure uses a safe generic summary and has no Retry task action.
S1-failed.expectedSemantics: Name failure in text and do not represent it only by red.

S1-search-empty.visibleData: A local title search has no matching tasks; Edit and Clear search remain available.
S1-search-empty.expectedSemantics: Distinguish no search results from the first-use empty task state.

S1-long-title.visibleData: A deterministic 120-code-point synthetic task title uses at most two visible lines.
S1-long-title.expectedSemantics: Preserve the full synthetic task title in the accessible name despite visible truncation.

S2-empty.visibleData: Empty composer; one read-only paired Host profile; locked Ask before edits policy; Mobile folders and attachments unavailable.
S2-empty.expectedSemantics: Expose the empty-draft Send reason and no clickable Host, policy, folder, or attachment selector.

S2-new-valid.visibleData: Valid synthetic draft; one read-only paired Host profile; locked Ask before edits policy; Mobile folders and attachments unavailable.
S2-new-valid.expectedSemantics: Keep Host profile and locked agent policy read-only and separate from unavailable Android file access.

S2-multiline.visibleData: Six-line synthetic draft preserves line breaks; profile rows and Send remain reachable; Mobile folders and attachments unavailable.
S2-multiline.expectedSemantics: Composer scrolling does not hide the read-only profile or Send action.

S2-new-ime.visibleData: Valid synthetic draft stays above the Android IME and Send remains reachable; Mobile folders and attachments unavailable.
S2-new-ime.expectedSemantics: Keep Send reachable while the Android IME is open.

S2-draft-restored.visibleData: Synthetic multiline draft and UTF-16 selection are restored with the immutable paired Host profile; Mobile folders and attachments unavailable.
S2-draft-restored.expectedSemantics: Announce restoration once without creating a task or claiming a restored mutable profile selection.

S2-offline.visibleData: Draft is retained while the paired Host is offline; Retry connection is available; Mobile folders and attachments unavailable.
S2-offline.expectedSemantics: Offline Send cannot appear successful and the exact draft remains editable.

S2-host-unavailable.visibleData: Draft is retained while the paired Host is unavailable; Retry connection is available; no Host selector exists.
S2-host-unavailable.expectedSemantics: Distinguish unavailable Host from network offline without offering a fake Host switcher.

S2-model-loading.visibleData: Immutable Host model profile is loading; Send is blocked; Mobile folders and attachments unavailable.
S2-model-loading.expectedSemantics: Label model loading with progress text and expose only the real refresh action.

S2-model-error.visibleData: Immutable Host model profile is unavailable; Retry model load is available; Mobile folders and attachments unavailable.
S2-model-error.expectedSemantics: Keep model-profile error separate from Host connection and Android file availability.

S2-send-pending.visibleData: Exact draft is retained while task creation is pending; duplicate Send and editing are disabled; no fake Cancel exists.
S2-send-pending.expectedSemantics: Announce pending once and do not present it as a completed task or cancellable remote operation.

S2-send-error.visibleData: Exact synthetic draft and UTF-16 selection are retained after a retryable Host error; Retry send is available.
S2-send-error.expectedSemantics: Confirm draft retention and expose Retry send only for the retryable terminal failure.

S2-attachment-unavailable.visibleData: Synthetic draft is valid; Mobile folders are unavailable until P3A; attachments are unavailable until P5; neither row is clickable.
S2-attachment-unavailable.expectedSemantics: State both unavailable capabilities without a picker, chevron, grant claim, or click action.

P2_6.purpose: Binding S3 Task Detail implementation contract over direct native Pi events, durable task commands, and phone-only layout reflow.

timeline-detached-jump.expectedSemantics: A detached timeline exposes one enabled Jump to latest action; activating it returns to the live edge and removes the action.

S3-snapshot-loading.visibleData: Task title and deterministic history loading state; no invented timeline activity.
S3-snapshot-loading.expectedSemantics: Announce task-history loading once and keep composer and Stop unavailable.

S3-starting.visibleData: Synthetic user prompt and native Pi Starting state with a separate Stop control.
S3-starting.expectedSemantics: Starting is distinct from streaming and Stop remains explicit.

S3-running.visibleData: Synthetic prompt; assistant text; three generic native Pi tool cards; explicit Steer or Follow-up selector; separate Stop.
S3-running.expectedSemantics: Timeline order is stable, current work is announced, and no mobile-file success is claimed.

S3-running-tool.visibleData: Tool-heavy native Pi timeline with generic safe summaries, no attachment entry, and no Android file operation claim.
S3-running-tool.expectedSemantics: Tool activity is presented directly from Pi without a Runtime Adapter or invented product action.

S3-tool-success.visibleData: Completed generic tool card with icon, text, and expandable safe result summary.
S3-tool-success.expectedSemantics: Tool success includes text and icon and remains distinct from whole-task completion.

S3-tool-failure.visibleData: Failed generic tool card with a safe error summary; no Retry tool action.
S3-tool-failure.expectedSemantics: Tool failure is distinct from task failure and exposes no unsupported retry control.

S3-waiting.visibleData: Native Pi waiting state and one synthetic question attention card; composer is blocked; Stop remains separate.
S3-waiting.expectedSemantics: The waiting reason is named and opening attention does not imply an answer was submitted.

S3-retrying.visibleData: Native Pi retry attempt one of three and the last settled timeline item; no duplicate activity.
S3-retrying.expectedSemantics: Retry is a live task state, blocks composer, and does not duplicate settled events.

S3-compacting.visibleData: Native Pi compaction status with preserved queued follow-up count.
S3-compacting.expectedSemantics: Compaction is one task state, blocks composer, and preserves the native queue.

S3-stopping.visibleData: Durable Stop fence is active; stopping is shown; composer and duplicate Stop are blocked.
S3-stopping.expectedSemantics: Stopping is never announced as stopped and only durable stopped proof releases the fence.

S3-stopped.visibleData: Stopped task history and prompt composer for a new direct Pi turn.
S3-stopped.expectedSemantics: Stopped state has one deterministic continuation path using session.prompt.

S3-completed.visibleData: Final assistant response, generic tool success, and prompt composer for a follow-on turn.
S3-completed.expectedSemantics: Completion remains distinct from outputs and supports a new direct Pi prompt.

S3-failed.visibleData: Generic task failure and retained prompt composer; no Retry task action.
S3-failed.expectedSemantics: Failure is named in text and continuation uses a new direct Pi prompt rather than a fake retry.

S3-offline.visibleData: Cached last-known running timeline; Host offline; draft cannot send; Stop may be durably saved on the phone.
S3-offline.expectedSemantics: Cached state is not current truth, and offline Stop persists before reconnect without claiming completion.

S3-replay.visibleData: Restoring native Pi events banner and deterministic historical timeline; no Stop recovery action.
S3-replay.expectedSemantics: Historical replay is distinct from new execution and unknown events remain diagnostic-only.

S3-partial-output.visibleData: Partial assistant text with one live streaming indicator and explicit running controls.
S3-partial-output.expectedSemantics: Only the active item updates during deltas; settled timeline identity remains stable.

S3-queued.visibleData: One active native Pi turn and one queued follow-up row; queue editing and deletion are absent.
S3-queued.expectedSemantics: Queue order and Steer versus Follow-up labels are explicit without unsupported queue mutation.

P2_7.purpose: Binding S4 Attention implementation contract for side-effect-free Pi questions and confirmations, a durable Android terminal ledger, and phone-only layout reflow.

S4-confirm.visibleData: Synthetic next-step summary and details; Allow once, Decline, and Dismiss actions.
S4-confirm.expectedSemantics: Allow once confirms only this request; Dismiss is non-terminal and does not authorize any Android capability.

S4-question.visibleData: Synthetic question with three options, one recommended option selected, and a custom-answer field.
S4-question.expectedSemantics: Options form one radio group; selection does not submit until Send answer is activated.

S4-responding.visibleData: The selected synthetic response is durably saved and waiting for Pi delivery proof; all response and dismissal actions are disabled.
S4-responding.expectedSemantics: Responding is announced once and is never announced as resolved before authoritative Pi delivery proof.

S4-resolved.visibleData: The synthetic answer reached Pi and the task can be reopened.
S4-resolved.expectedSemantics: Resolved is terminal only after Pi delivery proof, exposes one Return to task action, and retains the origin focus key.

S4-rejected.visibleData: The synthetic confirmation was explicitly declined and the task can be reopened.
S4-rejected.expectedSemantics: Declined is an explicit terminal decision and is never inferred from Dismiss, Back, or swipe.

S4-skipped.visibleData: The synthetic question was explicitly skipped and the task can be reopened.
S4-skipped.expectedSemantics: Skipped is a successful question outcome and remains distinct from a declined confirmation.

S4-expired.visibleData: The synthetic confirmation expired before a response; only Dismiss remains available.
S4-expired.expectedSemantics: Expiry is terminal locally, disables Allow once and Decline, and cannot reuse the stale call.

S4-cancelled.visibleData: The synthetic request was cancelled before it could be answered; the task can be reopened.
S4-cancelled.expectedSemantics: Host cancel or session stop is distinct from decline, skip, and expiry and never submits a user response.

S4-offline.visibleData: The synthetic draft answer and selection are retained while the paired Host is offline; Retry connection and Dismiss remain available.
S4-offline.expectedSemantics: Offline never implies a successful response and cannot create a terminal answer before reconnect.

S4-already-answered.visibleData: The Host already observed this synthetic request as handled; the task can be reopened without showing an answer or claiming Pi delivery.
S4-already-answered.expectedSemantics: A Host terminal observation disables a second response but does not claim a locally stored answer or authoritative Pi delivery proof.

disabledReasons.Answer: Answer must satisfy the visible validation rule.

S4-validation-error.visibleData: The synthetic custom answer is retained with a visible validation error; Edit answer, Skip, and Dismiss remain available.
S4-validation-error.expectedSemantics: The error is associated with the custom-answer field and Send answer remains disabled until valid.
